# temps_oidc_role_mapping (Resource)

Gives users in an identity-provider group a Temps role when they sign in through `temps_oidc_provider`.

Import with `<provider_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_oidc_role_mapping" "admins" {
  provider_id = temps_oidc_provider.sso.id
  idp_group   = "platform-admins"
  role        = "admin"
  priority    = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `idp_group` (String) Group name as the provider sends it.
- `priority` (Number) Higher priorities win when a user is in several mapped groups.
- `provider_id` (Number) ID of the OIDC provider.
- `role` (String) Temps role to grant, for example `admin`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<provider_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <provider_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_oidc_role_mapping.admins 2/5
```
